title: Flagships are original implementations
stmt: Flagships are original implementations learned from public behaviour and documentation; no incumbent code, binaries, assets or algorithms.

title: Flagship package ids and build tiers
stmt: Ids io.artcraft.flagship.<name>. Official builds omit only notice.standard (Cue, imported CEP, keeps it); permission notices come from risk() and sheet snapshots check them. Deckhand and Kiln add Community builds with notice.standard. Hosted builds: Halo AE and OFX, Strata AEIO, Argent 8bf, Tonemask UXP.

title: Flagship T1-T5 panels dock like
stmt: Every flagship panel is T1-T5 and docks like a built-in panel, including Tonemask.

title: Flagship targets measured nightly, PRs gate on counters
stmt: Targets run nightly on the machine classes and gate PRs through their counters; each plugin ships per-backend goldens, interaction scripts, a bench record and sheet snapshots; pen targets use 240 Hz scripted PenSample streams.

title: Free compute
stmt: Compute and kernels are never prompted.

title: Plugin-origin execution only through admit
stmt: Adapters must not call registry().execute_with with a plugin origin except through admit.

title: Hook points and bypass items
stmt: Point list adds before-render, after-render (export step), renderer3d.select, effects-presets.search and supervise (asynchronous refresh); bypass items add 'Render without plugin checks'.

title: Host recursion over plugin data is bounded
stmt: Stack overflow is not catchable, so host recursion over plugin-shaped data must be bounded by LIMITS and run on large-stack threads.

title: Golden comparisons name one class and one reference
stmt: Each golden names one class (exact, seeded, tolerant, nn) from its exec path and compares to that class's reference, never backend to backend.

title: Intercept points and redaction
stmt: Intercept payloads redacted to the subscriber's grants.

title: Lifecycle step: Discover
stmt: Catalogue index (TUF, hourly revocation snapshot) fetched by the host; search, ranks, listings (ext-store::catalogue, ext-manager::rank).

title: Lifecycle step: Download
stmt: Host-side network only; resumable; sha256 checked against catalogue pin; model data packages in parts (ext-store::store).

title: Lifecycle step: Enable
stmt: Grants persisted per app; contributions registered with the shell (menus, panels, tools, hooks) from index.bin without loading code (ext-runtime::registry).

title: Lifecycle step: Idle
stmt: keep_alive = "60s": worker suspended after 60 s idle unless audio is armed, a live preview is open, a surface is visible, a render contribution is active, a transaction is open or a job runs. keep_alive = "session": worker stays while app runs, resident memory shown in manager, suspended first under memory pressure. Suspension always delivers suspend with 50 ms for state.save into session storage before exit; next
detail: event delivers resume with that state.

title: Lifecycle step: Load
stmt: First event assigns a warm zygote worker from the pool to the package (replacement spawns off the critical path); 0.03-0.05 ms per AOT module load; 6 us pooled instantiation.

title: Lifecycle step: Pin and rollback
stmt: Per plugin; pinned versions never auto-update; rollback restores grants from that version (ext-store::state).

title: Lifecycle step: Prepare
stmt: AOT compile inside a worker (never in the app), HMAC-tagged into the cache; JS source compiled to engine bytecode or code cache inside the worker keyed by engine digest; WGSL validated per tier; declared-hot pipelines queued for warm-up; static GPU cost estimate; model sha256 checked and ONNX to CoreML conversion inside a worker where declared; Fluent parsed; SVG sanitised; index.bin rebuilt.

title: Lifecycle step: Re-prepare
stmt: After app, Wasmtime, JS engine, OS or driver update every cache keyed by that version misses. Re-preparation is lazy: first frame never waits, restored panels blit persisted display lists, a re-prepare queue runs at BACKGROUND QoS with at most 2 workers in recent-use order; a plugin used before its turn is prepared on demand at USER_INITIATED. Pipelines warm eagerly only for digests used by contributions in open
detail: documents or visible panels (declared-hot first), at most Reprepare.gpu = 32 per app across all plugins; everything else compiles on first use through the compile queue.

title: Lifecycle step: Run
stmt: Events, renders, jobs, hooks through the gate (ext-runtime).

title: Lifecycle step: Safe mode
stmt: --safe-mode, Shift at launch, CRAFT_SAFE_MODE=1, or the crash-loop detector (two crashes within 60 s of start whose journal names a plugin): no plugin code, hooks, intercepts, filters, shortcut overrides or data contributions run; the manager works (ext-runtime::rails).

title: Lifecycle step: Setup
stmt: One sheet lists every permission, hook, automatic-run kind, agent-exposure candidate (toggles default per decision 34; only the user changes them), service export, invokable commands, process, device, companion app and hotkey, a declared quota_mb, each declared model peak memory with one-tap raise when it exceeds the default account, other apps grants for suite-reach packages, and the risk level, with the
detail: third-party disclaimer. Only hardware input approves it (ext-manager::flow, ext-ui-fw::setup).

title: Lifecycle step: Start
stmt: Shell reads only index.bin (mmap, versioned, rkyv-style): per-app registrations, localised labels, compiled when bytecode, icon atlases 1x/2x, font descriptors. Restored panels draw from persisted laid-out display list (ext-ui-model::display, keyed by surface size and scale): a restore is a blit with no layout, shaping or tessellation, charged to StartupRestore (3 ms), not UiApply; a resized panel draws its list
detail: scaled until first layout. Workers start after the first frame in ordered cold-start order (visible panels, then contributions in open documents), min(cores/2, set) at a time. index.bin rebuilt on install, update, enable and locale change.

title: Lifecycle step: Uninstall
stmt: Kill workers; unregister; remove package when no app uses it; ask whether to delete settings and private storage; documents keep durable outputs and preserved data.

title: Lifecycle step: Update
stmt: Auto-update after cool-off (72 h Community, 24 h Verified, none Official); widening computed over the whole capability surface holds the update; previous version stays as rollback slot.

title: Lifecycle step: Verify
stmt: Signature, digest, provenance, zip rules, manifest parse, contract compatibility per app (Compat), permission parse, lookalike-name check, licence check (ext-store::unpack, ext-core::manifest).

title: Owner briefing before other workstreams
stmt: Only WS0 works before the briefing record: explainer reviewed; D-D, D-K, D-T answered or at built state; widenings D-B, D-C, D-E, D-F, D-G, D-P acknowledged or vetoed.

title: Machine classes for targets
stmt: Targets naming no class hold on all three: hw-mac (M4 Pro, macOS 15, UltraStudio 3G), hw-win (RTX 4070, Windows 11, DeckLink 4K, Kona 1), hw-linux (RX 7800 XT, Ubuntu 24.04 RADV, DeckLink Mini Monitor 4K). Each has an EOS R8 and a 120 Hz display; hw-mac and hw-win a Stream Deck, where its vendor app runs. Blender 4.2 LTS on each.

title: Plugin CLI
stmt: <app> plugins.

title: In-app manager
stmt: Window > Plugins in every app; same ext-manager::Model drawn by ext-ui-fw through.

title: Per-plugin isolation toggles
stmt: Per plugin the manager offers Run GPU work in an isolated device.

title: Launcher store
stmt: craft-launcher/apps/artcraft-launcher: catalogue browse across the suite.

title: No D-I N5 exception
stmt: Plugin-shipped and plugin-written expression code and libraries evaluate only in ext-expr; no N5 exception (R2).

title: New capabilities need no CUT gate
stmt: No old plugin system has GPU, PS or AE scripting, CEP, UXP or Figma compatibility; no CUT gate covers them.

title: No plugin codecs
stmt: Plugins never ship file codecs.

title: Every capability scheduled
stmt: Every capability is a plan task with a milestone, including the other Craft apps (WS-COM-ws15). Durations are estimates for one engineer plus agents; weeks count from M-1.

title: owner-never-stalled-by-plugin
stmt: No plugin-origin command stalls the owner thread past OwnerFrame; Stop-all always returns within CancelPoll plus one owner turn

title: Plugin output untrusted
stmt: Plugin output passes app parsers.

title: Plugin-owned panels, dialogs
stmt: Panels, dialogs and popovers belonging to the plugin, palette windows, HUDs.

title: APIs remove nuanced decisions
stmt: Retries on stale revisions, undo grouping, coalescing, determinism class, batching and size splitting are done by the host and SDK, not by authors.

title: App keeps authority; plugin holds capabilities
stmt: A Wasm plugin never holds a socket, process, preference handle or OS window; it holds host-minted handles checked at the sink. Real paths are a capability (files.paths) resolved and checked at the sink like handles.

title: No comments; code as proof
stmt: Every rule in the specification maps to a deterministic check in section 17.

title: Documents outlive plugins
stmt: Durable outputs and tolerant loading keep files working without the plugin and the UI says so; save, autosave, export and sync read only committed revisions.

title: Fail safe and visible
stmt: Every budget has a degrade ladder that ends in a badge, never in silent pass-through or silence.

title: Host draws chrome and trust UI
stmt: The host draws chrome and trust UI and never waits on a plugin to paint a frame.

title: Anything app can do via MCP or CLI a plugin can do
stmt: Anything the app can do through MCP or CLI a plugin can do, except network (excluded from this build), self-elevation and safety rails, and in-process plugin code (a placement rule).

title: No in-process code
stmt: Plugin code runs in worker or helpers only.

title: One gate, one place
stmt: Canonical ops, platform ops, adapter ops and bridged app commands pass through ext_runtime::gate::admit. Adapters map; they never decide.

title: UI never waits
stmt: The UI thread never waits on or runs plugin work.

title: Zero-copy media
stmt: Media moves by shared arenas, GPU handles and rings.

title: Quota widening
stmt: Raising quota_mb re-shows the sheet.

title: Render read rule
stmt: Render reads own layer, bound params and snapshots; more needs document.read.

title: restricted+gpu OpenGL
stmt: restricted+gpu includes OpenGL.

title: Atomic saves
stmt: A crash leaves old or new complete.

title: Script provenance
stmt: Plugin-written scripts run with the writer's authority.

title: All scripts run in a worker
stmt: extendscript@1 runs on ext-engine::js; script runs of every origin, user and agent included, run in a worker (role script) on the JIT engine; no app keeps an in-process script engine; the expression host is role expr on the same binary and profile.

title: Security corrections
stmt: Schema 3; GPU quotas per budgets; quarantine at 2 losses.

title: Flagship sheet lines
stmt: Each flagship lists permissions, level and notices.

title: Lend read-only
stmt: Producer outputs map read-only into consumers.

title: Host listeners
stmt: sink::net owns host listeners.

title: Suite rule amended
stmt: Trust boundaries name both native modes.

title: Common spec is the only definition of shared vocabulary
stmt: This document is the only definition of the shared vocabulary; security.md and every app document reference it and add only app-specific scope meanings, hook ids, drop targets and command classifications.

title: Sheet occlusion
stmt: Enable waits until nothing covers the sheet.

title: One layout, one painter
stmt: Plugin UI is laid out once in ext-ui-model::layout and painted once by ext-ui-paint.

title: UI thread never waits
stmt: The UI thread never waits on ext-ipc, GPU fences, rings.

title: User script sinks
stmt: User scripts run in the host script worker.

title: One owner decision list
stmt: decisions-v2.md is the only owner decision list; other documents cite D-ids. Open set: DEC-COM-owner-decision-ids.

title: Other apps host their incumbents' plugin kinds
stmt: Other apps host their incumbents' top plugin kinds: FilmCraft OFX; SoundCraft VST3, AU and CLAP plus audio.effect@1.0; VectorCraft and DesignCraft Illustrator and InDesign plug-ins; LightCraft .lrplugin; TextureCraft and MaterialCraft .sbsar; AniCraft rigs as .jsx (extendscript@1) and anim.ease@1.0.

title: Zero capability compromise
stmt: A plugin can do what EffectCraft's MCP server and CLI can do, plus windows, docked panels, menus, tools, overlays and behaviour hooks.

title: Conformance suite gates the adapter
stmt: ext_runtime::conformance::run::<EffectCraft>() gates the adapter.

title: Adapter only maps
stmt: Every CraftApp method only maps. The adapter has no permission logic and no transaction logic. ext_runtime::conformance::run::<EffectCraft>() gates it. Target size is at most 1,600 lines.

title: Owner-tagged arenas
stmt: Zeroed on scope or document change.

title: craft-ext test and bench
stmt: craft-ext test --app effectcraft --project fixtures/x.ecproj --frames 0..48 renders headless through effectcraft-cli with the plugin and compares golden EXRs within the tolerance for the plugin's determinism class. craft-ext bench --app effectcraft reports per-frame CPU, GPU, IPC and bytes.

title: Every budget number lives in BUDGETS
stmt: Every number lives in ext-runtime/src/budget.rs BUDGETS; EffectCraft names the CallClass and adds no Duration literal (conformance budgets_not_overridden).

title: Cache keys: compute
stmt: cache.compute keys by identity, context partition, class and key; partitions miss each other.

title: Cache keys: disk
stmt: The disk cache survives restarts with no stale pixels.

title: Cache keys: gpu-pipelines
stmt: GPU pipelines are keyed by validated IR digest and warmed at enable.

title: Cache keys: layer-input
stmt: Layer keys add RenderIdentity, time window, snapshot digests and aux producers.

title: Cache keys: ram-preview
stmt: RAM preview keys include identity; degraded frames are excluded.

title: Cache keys: simcache
stmt: SimCache keeps checkpoints and spills to disk (section 4.4).

title: Stateful and tolerant effects are cached
stmt: Stateful and tolerant effects are cached; state lives only in instance data or SimCache.

title: Export memory
stmt: Plugin memory joins export frame sizing.

title: Keep user state
stmt: Plugins never evict previews, cache or undo.

title: No plugin code in app
stmt: All plugin code runs out of the app.

title: No helper waits
stmt: App queues never wait on helpers.

title: Render wait budget
stmt: Render waits are bounded; final renders never degrade.

title: Revocation complete
stmt: Revocation stops every plugin path.

title: UI never waits
stmt: The UI applies prebuilt plugin UI only.

title: WGSL promotion
stmt: Bounded-loop IR promoted at validation.

title: Instances persist
stmt: Instances persist; reset on scope change or fault.

title: Expression library bound
stmt: Library failures show the pre-expression value.

title: fx.apply foreign
stmt: Callee faults return -7.

title: Nested render
stmt: Nested renders charge the outer class.

title: Sim stepping
stmt: Sims step in the frame class, then as a Job.

title: Async supervise
stmt: Form refresh is async.

title: Video output
stmt: Video output drops oldest, never waits.

title: No hidden state enforced by test
stmt: render_order_independence gates every effect.

title: Every network difference has an offline route
stmt: All 47 EffectCraft benchmark entries map with no gap. Illustrator live link, LAN farm submission, online licensing and CEP requests use offline routes: suite bus, farm folder, licence files, -9.

title: Plugin reach is 755 of 757 commands
stmt: Plugins reach 755 of 757 EffectCraft commands; only the 2 *.model.download commands are out, by the owner's network decision (N6); today plugins reach 35 ops (5%).

title: EffectCraft web build
stmt: EffectCraft adds nothing to the web backend: gate in the app Wasm, page and probation WebGPU devices, browser picker; native helpers, process.run and viewer.output return -8; scripts and ext-expr on QuickJS; CEP as T6 iframes.

title: Window and dialog commands derive
stmt: The 27 UiWindow and UiDialog commands derive app.windows (gesture-only) per common 6.2.

title: Video-io devices are bus-attached only
stmt: video-io devices only on PCIe, Thunderbolt or USB; IP video returns -9 Excluded.

title: Script process calls use process.run
stmt: file.executeFile and system.callSystem map to process.run.

title: Native hosts use the native-UI sandbox
stmt: craft-aehost and the OFX bridge launch with the native-UI profile; dialogs carry native notices.

title: Media decode out of process
stmt: All image and video bytes parse in craft-media-decode.

title: One origin per batch
stmt: User and plugin edits never share a batch.

title: FigCraft command classes
stmt: Every FigCraft command is classified to one permission or -9; generated, not hand-written.

title: FigCraft sink lint
stmt: clippy-sinks bans direct OS calls.

title: UI node code and Code Connect writes
stmt: UI node code{text,syntax,line_numbers} is part of UI level 1.5.

title: Manifest-declared codegen preferences
stmt: [[contribution.codegen.preference]] types: enum (select) with options and default.

title: Reference closure for codegen reads
stmt: Reads reach the inspected subtree plus everything it refers.

title: Display pass toggle and badge
stmt: View > Display passes lists each enabled package's passes with checkmark.

title: Display passes viewport-only
stmt: Display passes never reach documents, exports or files.

title: DocIndex
stmt: Lazy incremental node index off the owner.

title: Tear-off and re-dock state machine
stmt: DockPlacement::{Docked{area,group,index}, Floating{rect,monitor}} stored per panel id.

title: Drag from panel to canvas
stmt: T1 grid and list rows carry drag:{kind: svg|image|component|token, payload_ref}

title: Effect mask check
stmt: Mask checked before spec.run.

title: FigCraft device loss
stmt: Loss shows durable fills, then re-creates textures.

title: No first-use hitch
stmt: Device creation runs off the UI thread.

title: FigCraft web GPU
stmt: On web GT1-GT3, GT4 and WGSL nn use the common validator and the page WebGPU device once promoted, the probation GPUDevice before. With only WebGL2, GT1-GT3 report false and filters use their CPU form or durable; display passes stay render pipelines; compute passes return -8.

title: Heavy writes routed by Meta.cost at gate step 11
stmt: gate::admit step 11 routes writes from Meta.cost and DocumentHost::size: a heavy node.set, boolean, flatten, svg.import or builder insert runs detached on the job pool and reports progress to the job board after 250 ms; other writes take the live-writer lease and reach the owner as single commands inside the drain loop's turns. One command is never split across frames and no size limit forces a plugin to use a job.
detail: The owner drain budget is OwnerFrame for the whole app; remaining calls wait for the next wake, charged to their plugin.

title: FigCraft hook table
stmt: The hook table is generated from CraftApp::hooks() with redacted intercept payloads; the fx.apply registry is empty.

title: image.replace remains for apply plugins
stmt: image.replace with an image.create result stays as the destructive form for apply plugins.

title: Selection-scope commands get ids from captured scope
stmt: The gate's scope step rewrites ids from the captured scope for every command with Meta.scope = Selection (table-driven; sec 4.2).

title: FigCraft JIT engine
stmt: @craft/figcraft runs on the worker JIT: V8 on desktop, QuickJS on web.

title: Journal origin
stmt: edit.repeat replays user entries only.

title: Live write policy
stmt: collab.write derived per step and rechecked at commit; policy may limit to user-invoked.

title: Live session max_changes enforced at commit
stmt: Before commit figcraft_collab::weight(changes) is compared with the session's max_changes; if over, the commit returns -6 Budget {detail:{kind:"LiveSessionMax"}} and rolls back; cx.edit splits by that limit with app.figcraft.history.commit so authors never see it.

title: MCP surface generated from Meta
stmt: MCP (crates/mcp): tool schemas and read-only/destructive hints are generated from Meta; plugin commands appear only for plugins that opt in, on by default for L0-L1; plugin text returned to agents is marked untrusted data.

title: All 630 commands carry Meta, none undeclared
stmt: 100% of the 630 commands declare Meta; no Meta::UNDECLARED remains at the end of F1.

title: Automatic draft covers about 80%, rest by hand
stmt: Expected automatic Meta coverage is about 80% (estimate); the remainder is written by hand during review.

title: No plugin failure crashes FigCraft
stmt: Every plugin failure class in the sec 10 table is contained without crashing the app: traps, loops, OOM, worker death, command panics, call floods, huge reads/writes, stuck events, oversize data, malformed widget or codegen output, hostile importers, unknown plugin data, peer floods, GPU hang or device loss, slow or invalid display passes, hostile media, malformed vectors, first GPU use

title: FigCraft has one plugin system
stmt: FigCraft has exactly one plugin system, the shared Runtime<A> through the mapping-only FigCraft: CraftApp adapter; the figcraft.session@1.2 runtime (912 non-test and 1,179 test lines) and its engine and shell hooks (about 1,200 lines) are deleted in the same change.

title: Owner drain runs on every wake, not paint
stmt: The fork's App::on_wake (UserEvent::Wake from wake_owner, input, timers, window events) calls runtime.drain_owner(now) on every wake, never eframe::App::update or paint, so plugin work progresses while the window is minimized or occluded. Drain loop, round-robin turns and budget are ext-runtime::owner under CallClass::OwnerFrame.
detail: Reads and pure ops never reach the owner thread; heavy commands run detached and reach it only as one install.

title: Path params
stmt: Handles, or paths with files.paths.

title: PerNode and PerPixel command families
stmt: PerNode: node.set and every Params(ids) edit, bool.*, vector.flatten, vector.outlineStroke, object.batchRename, edit.findReplace, layout.* reflow, component.detach/instance.detach on large trees, data.fill, object.group/ungroup, edit.delete, edit.duplicate, svg.import and every plugin-origin builder insert. PerPixel: image.create, video.create, image.crop, fill.* image edits. Everything else Const.

title: Inspector shows synced plugin keys
stmt: Inspector > Plugin data (sec 3.6) shows every synced plugin key with its server writer.

title: PluginHost::route replaces runtime intercept
stmt: The intercept at the top of execute (rt.commands(), rt.busy()) is replaced by PluginHost::route(id); contributed commands run through the runtime and 'a plugin gesture is in progress' is DocumentHost::busy.

title: figma-compat pluginDrop handling
stmt: figma-compat's page shim injected into every showUI page intercepts.

title: Provenance stamp
stmt: Server stamps each plugin-data writer.

title: Plugins reach 630 non-refused commands
stmt: Plugins reach every one of the 630 commands not refused by common 5.4, the refused ids being generated from Meta as the N1-N7 id map and the N6 exclusion list; built-in windows are app.windows, Help links ui.open_url, presence collab.presence, files are handles or real paths with files.paths; edit.repeat and command.batch are reachable under app.scripts with the plugin's Authorization carried into the nested command.

title: Reads run detached and create no owner task
stmt: Reads (pure canonical and adapter ops, node.get, node.tree, node.find, app.figcraft.node.query, path.get, geometry.outline, export.render) run through exec_detached on runtime threads against the event's snapshot plus the transaction's own detached writes and never create an owner task.

title: FigCraft removals
stmt: Remove [why], per-contribution permissions, the 50,000-entry cap, fixed 10 s and 2 s budgets and FIGCRAFT_SAFE_MODE.

title: Runner election
stmt: One runner delivers peer-caused events.

title: Every call is charged to the plugin's account
stmt: Every call is charged by bytes and wall time to the plugin's account (HostCall).

title: All 46 specs() sources edited mechanically
stmt: All 46 specs() sources (cmd/* modules plus codegen, devinspect, component_codegen, playground, code_connect, annotations, dev_resources, collab, live, online, fonts, vectoredit, shapebuilder and others) get Meta; every fn(&mut Session,&Value) touching only the document becomes fn(&mut DocState,&Value,&Authorization).

title: T6 in the web build relies on common 11.7
stmt: plugin_host/web.rs wasm32 backend over ext-web::iframe behind craft-plugin-web's WebHost trait (R33); common 11.7 alone defines origin, sandbox, bootstrap, service worker, routes, CSP, navigation lock and refusal (C20, K1).

title: Web build windows are DOM elements
stmt: A visible page is an absolutely positioned element over the egui canvas with host-drawn.

title: UI requests carry origin
stmt: Queued UI requests keep their origin.

title: Video sync
stmt: Videos sync like images; web uses WebCodecs.

title: Warp split targets
stmt: Warp gated as GPU, result and preview.

title: External links
stmt: Page links go to the URL sheet on activation.

title: Web folder picks
stmt: Directory handles on Chromium, OPFS import elsewhere.

title: Web T6 without WebRTC block
stmt: Iframe UIs work on all browsers; package script runs in a Worker realm.

title: Widget export, copy and memory limits
stmt: Export renders the snapshot as vectors; copy/paste carries node, state and snapshot.

title: Widget click, menu, input
stmt: Clicks hit-test regions and send widget.click{node,region,user} as a user-invoked event.

title: Collaborator without the widget can
stmt: Peer-caused state changes re-render only on the runner with no capabilities.

title: figcraft change: §4.5
stmt: Banner is notice.standard, live_session and sync; the Network location badge is from broker::fs::sync_state().

title: FigCraft binds to common v2
stmt: Common v2 alone defines permissions, Meta, exposure, sinks, ops, errors, traits, gate and budgets; FigCraft adds scope meanings, classifications, hooks, drop targets and app changes.

title: PhotoCraft plugin code rules
stmt: crates/plugins forbids unsafe code (arena mapping lives in ext-worker), keeps the existing clippy denies (unwrap_used, expect_used, panic), has no code comments (comment ratchet), names every limit as a const with a test; GPU budgets and quotas are craft-gpu's and no_app_gpu_budget_literals fails on any in the app.

title: PhotoCraft staging-belt hand-off
stmt: Adopt the staging-belt upload and read-only hand-off of EffectCraft 5.2 for adjacent plugin filters, with the same counters.

title: PhotoCraft hook table
stmt: Hook-point table generated from CraftApp::hooks() with redacted intercept payloads; fx.apply via apply_builtin; canvas.pointer and export.* events.

title: PhotoCraft GT3 pipelines
stmt: GT3 pipelines use packaged WGSL digests or generated modules (gpu::Source::Generated, under gpu.compile) with bounded-loop IR promoted at validation; Filter Forge graphs compile to one fused module per connected region; GT3 is gpu.api under permission gpu.direct; native filter helpers follow the Fence rule.

title: PhotoCraft schema 3 manifests
stmt: C20 parses PhotoCraft's panel, CPU-tile and GPU brush engine, imported ExtendScript and synthesised 8bf folder manifests.

title: Plugins never crash
stmt: No plugin failure (trap, loop, OOM, worker, helper or 8bf death, handoff or page hang, GPU hang, bad output, slow preview, missing plugin, floods, memory pressure, panic, save or quit) affects the app or document.

title: No in-process wasmi in PhotoCraft app
stmt: The in-process craft_ext_host::wasm dependency (wasmi in the app process) disappears from PhotoCraft (invariant 1); about 5,600 lines of adapter and engine plugin code are replaced.

title: PhotoCraft CEP host table
stmt: Node and CEP tables live in ext-js; PhotoCraft keeps only its host table (photoshop.jsx@1 for evalScript, PhotoshopRegisterEvent via psdesc::record) and .zxp import.

title: PhotoCraft plugin performance rules
stmt: No plugin call on the UI thread's critical path (owner drain under BUDGETS[OwnerFrame], Cost::heavy via exec_detached); no whole-layer materialisation (whole-target access only via pixels.read with a byte budget); previews substitute in the compositor without copies; durable output is never copied; arenas are pooled and cleared before reuse.
detail: Interchange is the native form; RGBA16F when a plugin asks for float without depth.

title: Benches gate speed
stmt: Figures are bench-gated per PR and nightly.

title: Engine plugin_host holds no transaction code
stmt: Only PhotoCraft-specific mapping stays in crates/engine/src/plugin_host; transactions, scope, write sets, plugin-step journals, rebase and modal scopes live in ext-runtime, lint no_engine_txn_outside_runtime keeps them out, and plugin_host/{txn,scope,journal}.rs do not exist in v2.

title: Plugin-written scripts carry origin
stmt: Plugin-written .jsx, .js and .atn run as Origin::Plugin(writer) or after the host sheet; user and agent .jsx runs use the host script worker.

title: PhotoCraft T6 on CEF
stmt: T6 runs on CEF; windows are topmost only with ui.window:topmost; only undocked windows count toward the T6 limit.

title: Web build backend
stmt: PhotoCraft and FigCraft web builds use the ext-worker web backend; O8 and C11-web join their acceptance; FigCraft gets the C24 probe.

title: App never stalls
stmt: Plugin code runs out of process.

title: Activity log UI and privacy
stmt: Activity tab per plugin with filters and Reveal for files.

title: CEF delivery
stmt: CEF (about 120 MB) is a platform component installed by the host store with the launcher.

title: Decisions flip data not code
stmt: Every switchable capability is built, tested in both states and selected by one field of BUILD_DEFAULTS; a veto or owner amendment is a one-line change.

title: Permissions enforced where the effect happens
stmt: The gate computes an effect mask per call and every sink checks it; manifests and lock files are inputs to that check, never the check.

title: Engine security
stmt: Zeroed sessions, 1 ms clocks, no WASI files.

title: Everything grantable
stmt: Every capability grantable with permission, risk and disclaimer; only N1-N7 refused.

title: Full-mode rules
stmt: Pinned signers; residual file reach disclosed; WFP tree has no network.

title: Global user controls
stmt: Safe mode.

title: GPU quotas
stmt: Over-quota fails only the plugin call.

title: Host risk label
stmt: One host-computed label.

title: Inv 1 no in-process code
stmt: No plugin machine code in app processes.

title: Inv 2 sink authority
stmt: Authority checked at the sink.

title: Inv 3 scope
stmt: Scope enforced on what changes.

title: Inv 4 hardware gesture
stmt: Only hardware input approves or gestures.

title: Inv 5 operator channel
stmt: No plugin reaches the operator channel.

title: Inv 6 vocabulary
stmt: One vocabulary, one risk function.

title: Inv 7 render read-only
stmt: Render is read-only and deterministic.

title: Inv 8 output untrusted
stmt: Plugin output is validated.

title: Inv 9 agents
stmt: Agents treat plugin text as data.

title: Inv 10 GPU
stmt: GPU code validated and owner-initialised.

title: Inv 11 services
stmt: Consumer authority; provider levels pinned.

title: Inv 12 widening
stmt: Widening covers the whole surface.

title: Inv 13 revocation
stmt: Revocation bounded and complete.

title: Inv 14 accounts
stmt: One account per plugin.

title: Inv 15 parsers
stmt: Plugin bytes and strings bounded.

title: Inv 16 no network
stmt: No plugin network path; N6 items -9.

title: Inv 17 consent
stmt: Plugins cannot produce consent.

title: Inv 18 stop and recover
stmt: User can always see, stop, recover.

title: Inv 19 outbound sheets
stmt: Outbound paths go through host sheets.

title: Inv 20 redaction
stmt: Events carry only readable data.

title: Inv 21 switches
stmt: Both switch states built and tested.

title: Inv 22 disclosure
stmt: Disclosures true and complete.

title: Inv 23 web content
stmt: Web content charged to the plugin.

title: Inv 24 devices
stmt: Devices local or owner-labelled.

title: Main app entitlements
stmt: Library validation on, no JIT.

title: Plugin manager per-plugin controls
stmt: Per plugin the user controls every optional permission, contribution toggle, hook.

title: No just-in-time prompts
stmt: Missing permission returns -2; request sheet optional.

title: Offline by construction
stmt: No plugin process or page has a network path; full helpers deny direct and indirect network.

title: Rule-test mapping
stmt: Every security rule has a test.

title: Switch tests
stmt: Switch tests construct both states.

title: Tiers
stmt: Tier is identity shown beside risk; L3/L4 by tier with pins, provenance or two-step; update delays 0/24/72 h.

title: Supply chain
stmt: TUF index with offline root, Sigstore provenance, pinned hashes and signers, HMAC grants, hourly revocation, submission checks.

title: Windows floor
stmt: Windows 10 1703 minimum.
